# WebAssembly specification and core test suite

The formal WebAssembly 3.0 specification (SpecTec sources), the prose core
specification and the official core test suite, vendored for the Lean
WebAssembly engine `WasmVM` (issue
[#1244](https://github.com/danbri/factoidal/issues/1244)). The test suite is
also converted to JSON command lists plus `.wasm` binaries, so a runner needs
no `.wast` text parser at first.

| | |
|---|---|
| Upstream | https://github.com/WebAssembly/spec |
| Commit | `f3268fa9dcb7d3a60d09546e743e7281e75cddb0` (2026-11-06, "[spectec] Remove obsolete EXTEND instruction") |
| Browse | https://github.com/WebAssembly/spec/tree/f3268fa9dcb7d3a60d09546e743e7281e75cddb0 |
| Fetched | 2026-11-07, `git fetch --depth 1` of that commit |
| Changes | None. Files are copied unmodified. `test/core-json/` is generated by us (see below). |

## Licences, per directory

The upstream top-level `LICENSE` (copied here as `LICENSE`) says each
top-level directory carries its own terms:

```
document/       - W3C Software and Document Notice and License
specification/  - W3C Software and Document Notice and License
spectec/        - Apache License 2.0
interpreter/    - Apache License 2.0
test/           - Apache License 2.0
```

| Here | Licence | Licence text vendored |
|---|---|---|
| `specification/wasm-3.0/` | W3C Software and Document Notice and License | `specification/LICENSE-W3C-from-document-core.txt` |
| `document/core/` | W3C Software and Document Notice and License | `document/core/LICENSE` (full text); `document/LICENSE` (pointer) |
| `test/core/` | Apache-2.0 | `test/LICENSE` |
| `test/core-json/` | Apache-2.0 (derived from `test/core/`) | `test/LICENSE` |

Where the W3C text is: upstream has **no** `specification/LICENSE` (a fetch
of it returns 404). `document/LICENSE` is a two-line pointer to
https://www.w3.org/copyright/software-license/. The full licence text is in
`document/core/LICENSE` ("W3C SOFTWARE AND DOCUMENT NOTICE AND LICENSE",
2015 version). We copy that file unchanged into `specification/` as
`LICENSE-W3C-from-document-core.txt`, so the full notice sits beside the
SpecTec files, as the licence requires for every copy.

## Files

`specification/wasm-3.0/` — 37 SpecTec files (0.3 MB), the formal spec from
which the prose, the reference interpreter and the theorem-prover backends are
generated:

```
0.1-aux.vars 0.2-aux.num 0.3-aux.seq
1.0-syntax.profiles 1.1-syntax.values 1.2-syntax.types 1.3-syntax.instructions 1.4-syntax.modules
2.0-validation.contexts 2.1-validation.types 2.2-validation.subtyping 2.3-validation.instructions 2.4-validation.modules
3.0-numerics.relaxed 3.1-numerics.scalar 3.2-numerics.vector
4.0-execution.configurations 4.1-execution.values 4.2-execution.types 4.3-execution.instructions 4.4-execution.modules
5.1-binary.values 5.2-binary.types 5.3-binary.instructions 5.4-binary.modules
6.0-text.lexical 6.1-text.values 6.2-text.types 6.3-text.instructions 6.4-text.modules
7.0-soundness.contexts 7.1-soundness.configurations
X.1-notation.syntax X.2-notation.typing X.3-notation.execution X.4-notation.binary X.5-notation.text
```

(each name ends in `.spectec`). Not copied from `specification/`: the
`wasm-1.0/`, `wasm-2.0/` and `wasm-latest/` trees, the `Makefile` and the
two sync scripts.

`document/core/` — the whole prose core spec source as upstream has it (68
files, 0.9 MB): 47 reStructuredText chapters in `intro/ syntax/ valid/ exec/
binary/ text/ appendix/`, plus the Sphinx build files (`conf.py`, `Makefile`,
`util/` with `macros.def`, `static/`), the Bikeshed entry `index.bs`, and
`LICENSE`. Not copied: the rest of `document/` (JS API, Web API, legacy
proposal documents, metadata).

`test/core/` — all of upstream `test/core/` (300 files, 12.3 MB): 259 `.wast`
files plus `run.py`, `README.md` and the SIMD generator scripts in
`simd/meta/`.

| Directory | `.wast` files |
|---|---|
| `test/core/` (top level) | 97 |
| `bulk-memory/` | 8 |
| `exceptions/` | 5 |
| `gc/` | 17 |
| `memory64/` | 25 |
| `multi-memory/` | 41 |
| `relaxed-simd/` | 7 |
| `simd/` | 59 |

Nothing in `test/core/` was left out. Not copied from `test/`: `js-api/`,
`harness/`, `legacy/` and the other non-core suites.

## Machine-readable tests: `test/core-json/`

Every `.wast` file becomes a directory with the same relative path and name,
holding `<name>.json` (the command list: `module`, `assert_return`,
`assert_trap`, `assert_invalid`, `assert_malformed`, `register`, `action`, ...)
and the modules it names: `<name>.<n>.wasm` for binary modules and
`<name>.<n>.wat` for modules that upstream gives only as text
(`assert_malformed` / `module quote` cases, which must be rejected by a text
parser and so have no binary). Example:
`test/core-json/simd/simd_lane/simd_lane.json`.

The JSON format is that of wabt's `wast2json`
(https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/blob/main/docs/wast2json.md), as emitted
by `wasm-tools json-from-wast`.

- Tool: `wasm-tools 1.263.0` (Bytecode Alliance; Homebrew), command per file:
  `wasm-tools json-from-wast <file>.wast -o <name>.json --wasm-dir .`
  run inside the output directory.
- Fallback, used only if `wasm-tools` fails on a file:
  `wast2json --enable-all` from wabt 1.0.42. It was not needed.
- Result: 259 of 259 files converted by `wasm-tools`; 0 used the fallback;
  0 failed. Per-file outcomes: `test/core-json/conversion-log.tsv`.
- Output: 7,476 files, 16.1 MB (259 JSON, 5,967 `.wasm`, 1,249 `.wat`).
  `simd/` is 8.9 MB of that.

Regenerate from the repository root:

```
tools/wasmvm/convert-spec-tests.sh
```

It needs `wasm-tools` (and `wast2json` for the fallback):
`brew install wasm-tools wabt`.
